landing.heroTagline: Unified Resource & Project Management for EUV Program IS
landing.heroDescription: A unified management platform replacing SharePoint and Excel-based workflows, providing worklog tracking, resource forecasting, and milestone management in one place.
landing.problemsSubtitle: Eliminating inefficiencies in existing workflows and supporting data-driven decisions.
landing.scatteredDataDesc: Consolidating information scattered across SharePoint and Excel files into a single source.
landing.manualTrackingDesc: Tracking worklogs and resource status through an automated system instead of manual management.
landing.limitedVisibilityDesc: Instantly understand project status through real-time dashboards and reports.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Providing all the features needed for engineering resource management.
landing.worklogTrackingDesc: Record daily work hours per project, with AI auto-classification.
landing.resourceForecastingDesc: Plan monthly FTE allocation and visualize with resource matrix.
landing.projectManagementDesc: Track project lifecycle and PCP gates (G3, G5, G6).
landing.teamDashboardDesc: View individual and team dashboards for period-based status at a glance.
landing.aiWeeklySummaryDesc: AI-generated weekly summaries and auto-insights for work status awareness.
landing.howToUseSubtitle: Start resource management in 3 simple steps.
landing.step1Desc: Record daily work hours per project.
landing.step2Desc: Set and allocate monthly FTE targets.
landing.step3Desc: Monitor progress through dashboards and reports.
